TikTok Ads

Turn short-form creative into a measurable customer journey.

TAOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

TikTok Ads supports advertising campaigns and documented business API capabilities in eligible markets. MoreSpace can build a reviewed creative testing process, connect relevant landing experiences, and assess customer outcomes while keeping market availability, event definitions, and platform-specific reporting denominators explicit.

Useful outputs

  • Structured creative tests and campaign naming conventions
  • Validated conversion or enquiry handoffs with campaign context
  • Performance reports with explicit denominator and attribution definitions

Where we can apply it

  • Creative brief → approved video variants → TikTok campaign → landing enquiry.
  • Eligible conversion event → quality checks → campaign report → acquisition analysis.
  • Platform spend → CRM or purchase outcomes → attribution review → experiment decision.
01

Use case 1

Plan short-form creative variants around an approved offer and audience.

02

Use case 2

Connect eligible conversion events and customer enquiries with reporting.

03

Use case 3

Compare creative engagement with qualified leads, purchases, and acquisition costs.

Inputs we need

  • Eligible target markets, audience definitions, and approved budget
  • Reviewed video creative, claims, and landing-page destinations
  • Conversion event plan, customer values, and qualification criteria

Delivery sequence

  • Confirm market eligibility and agree the offer, objective, and conversion meaning.
  • Configure reviewed creative and test authorized events and lead handoffs.
  • Run approved experiments and compare platform engagement with customer outcomes.

Expert review points

  • Approve creative rights, claims, market eligibility, and spending limits.
  • Review event quality and reporting denominators before comparing conversion rates.
